messages:
Aria: quick sync on recurring incidents — we've seen a steady uptick in three patterns: scale-down races, cache-eviction cascades, and model-swap rollbacks. Need owners, short mitigations, and measurable success criteria.

Sam: Agree. Can we get counts and median mttr for each pattern so we can prioritize?

Tomas: Pulled numbers: last 8 weeks = 11 recurrences. scale-down: 5 (mttr 16m), cache-evict: 4 (mttr 22m), model-swap: 2 (mttr 35m). I'll attach export to the recurrence board.

Aria: OK. Proposals: short-term fixes + owners.

Riley: I'll own cache-evict mitigations. Short-term: enable prefix hot-cache, tighten batch-size variance guards at ingress. Rollout: feature-flag -> one region canary (48h) -> global. Success metric: 50% drop in 5xx from cache within 4 weeks. ETA short-term: 2w.

Sam: I'll take scale-down races. Short-term: increase grace period from 30s to 90s for warm pools; disable aggressive downscale schedules during nightly backups. Rollout: canary on pool A -> full in 72h. Success metric: pod churn down by 60% and recurrence count halved. ETA: 1w.

Tomas: model-swap owner: Tomas. Short-term: add tokenization preflight and binary checksum check before swap. Block swap if token mismatch >0.2%. ETA: 3w. Success metric: zero repeat model-swap rollbacks for next quarter.

infra-bot: ticket created: #INC-2026-1187 "Cache eviction cascade" linked.

Aria: Good. We need one-line action items for the recurrence board in this format: "owner | action | ETA"

Riley: "Riley | enable prefix hot-cache + batch-size guard | 2026-04-08"

Sam: "Sam | increase scale-down grace window + backup gating | 2026-04-01"

Tomas: "Tomas | add tokenization preflight + checksum in swap pipeline | 2026-04-15"

Aria: Add brief playbook snippets for oncall so incidents can be mitigated immediately. Keep to 3 steps max.

Riley: Cache playbook: 1) enable read-only mode on cache 2) flip prefix hot-cache flag 3) scale up cache nodes for region.

Sam: Scale-down playbook: 1) increase graceful window 2) disable downscale for pool 3) move traffic to warm pool.

Tomas: Model-swap playbook: 1) revert to previous model variant 2) run tokenization sample 3) block further swaps and notify model-onboarding.

Aria: I ran this search to compile incidents:
```
incidents list --tag recurrence --since 2026-02-01 --service inference-runtime --csv
```

Sam: I'll open infra PR for the graceful-window toggle and add canary rollout steps.

Riley: I'll add the cache metrics dashboard (cache hit ratio, 502 rate) and set threshold alert at low levels.

Tomas: Confirming ownership :white_check_mark:. Will post pipeline jobs and tests.

Sam: Confirming :white_check_mark:.

Riley: Confirming :white_check_mark:.

Aria: Thanks — Jordan (ops lead) will audit if any owner has >4 open remediations. We'll meet again in 7 days to review canary results. Closing thread and posting action items to the recurrence board. :rocket:
